newsitem.title: CHINA: Duracell's China battery plant opens.
newsitem.headline: Duracell's China battery plant opens.

text.p: Duracell International Inc of the United States officially opened its joint venture battery plant in China on Monday and said it would expand investment to more than $100 million over the next five years.
A spokeswoman for Duracell said it would have a 90 percent stake in the joint venture with China's Huaxin Industry and Commerce Corp in Dongguan in the southern province of Guangdong.
"Duracell and its partner expect in the next five years to aggressively expand the plant... bringing total investment to over $100 million," Duracell said in a statement.
The plant would have production capacity of one billion AA and AAA alkaline batteries a year, Duracell said. The majority of the output would be exported.
